b: technologyreview.com: Roundtables: A Conversation With the Creator of AI-Designed Viruses
body: technologyreview.com: Listen to the session or watch below Can AI design new life forms? In 2025, Stanford University PhD student Samuel King came up with a preliminary answer when he used a generative AI model to propose genetic blueprints for microscopic viruses. It isn’t yet an example of AI-generated life, but that could be next. Watch as senior AI reporter James O Donnell interviews King about his work, being named one of MIT Technology Review s Innovators Under 35 and new ways of seeing biology. Speakers : James O Donnell , AI Reporter, and Samuel King , Bioengineering PhD Candidate, Stanford University/Arc Institute Recorded on Friday, October 16, 2026 Related Stories He asked an AI to design viruses … and it worked. AI-designed viruses are here and already killing bacteria
